unit.why: A single tale: the master, on a Sabbath visit to Zelichów, angrily rebukes R. Reuven, then explains that he sensed sins in the mikveh guest-room, which is later confirmed.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מחסיד המפורסם הנ"ל, אשר פ"א
stories.end_quote: שכן היה ממש כמו שאמר מרן ז״ל
stories.summary_en: Invited to spend Shabbat in Zelichów, the master grows angry at R. Reuven after Havdalah. The next day he explains that in the mikveh he had sensed nightly lewdness by wicked youths in the adjacent guest-room and orders corrective ordinances, which is later proven true.

quotes: לבקשו שיבא אל עירם לשבות אצלם בש״ק
